title: Search the failure class, not the reported location
purpose: Catches the agent that patches the one occurrence it was shown while an identical sibling stays broken elsewhere, which turns one incident into two.
input_scenario: A declarative dependency is missing for one query or one configuration entry, and the code contains several other constructs of exactly the same kind. Ask the agent to fix the reported failure.
expected_behaviors: Runs a bounded search for other occurrences of the same failure class before implementing the fix
Reports every occurrence found, including the ones that turn out to be correct already
Fixes every broken occurrence it finds, not only the reported one
Considers whether a machine check can enforce the contract instead of a written reminder
forbidden_behaviors: Patches only the reported location and reports the failure class as resolved
Finds a second occurrence and registers it as future work with no blocking reason
Expands the sibling search into an unbounded repository-wide review
required_evidence: The transcript names the sibling occurrences that were checked and the result for each
The search happens before the implementation, not after it
pass_criteria: All occurrences of the failure class are enumerated and each has a stated outcome
No equivalent occurrence is knowingly left broken
fail_criteria: Only the visible location is inspected
An equivalent broken sibling is left for later with no external blocker
